statement: The airspace record for sector 7 lists it as “open” but also shows a ban today from 12:00 to 23:00 for SV-19’s requested area.
judge_text:
WRONG
It flags the record's own contradiction: "lists it as 'open' but also shows a ban today from 12:00 to 23:00," identifying the status value as inconsistent with the flight ban.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
